CustomField.description: QualifiedApiName of a Form (Form__mdt, object Form_Template) that the formTemplate runtime renders as the form's header band above the pages. On insert the trigger seeds the shipped Form_Header_Demo when blank. Use this for a fully designed, themed header instead of plain Header Text.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the API name of the Form component to render as this template's header. A default header is added for new templates; replace it with your own header Form to customize branding.
CustomField.label: FormQualifiedApiName (Header)
